admission_schedule.query: When will NPGC admission forms be available for 2026-27?
admission_schedule.answer: Admission forms for 2026-27 will be available from January 15, 2026. You can apply online at www.admission.npgc.in or in person at Counter No. 1 (College Administrative Block).

admission_schedule.query: What is the last date to submit the admission form at NPGC?
admission_schedule.answer: The last date for submission of admission forms is May 31, 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be accepted.

eligibility_criteria.query: What is the eligibility criteria for BCA admission at NPGC?
eligibility_criteria.answer: For BCA admission, you need to have passed 10+2 with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks and Mathematics or Computer Science as one of the subjects. SC/ST candidates get a 5% relaxation in marks.

eligibility_criteria.query: Am I eligible for B.Com (Hons.) if I didn't take Commerce in 12th?
eligibility_criteria.answer: No, for B.Com (Hons.), you must have either Commerce, Economics, or Mathematics as one of the subjects in 12th. Additionally, you need a minimum of 60% aggregate marks (55% for SC/ST).

eligibility_criteria.query: If I passed 10th class before 2022, can I take admission in NPGC?
eligibility_criteria.answer: No, you are not eligible for undergraduate programs at NPGC if you passed your 10th class examination before 2022. This is a mandatory requirement by the college.

eligibility_criteria.query: What are the relaxations for SC/ST candidates in NPGC admission?
eligibility_criteria.answer: SC/ST candidates get a 5% relaxation in the minimum aggregate marks required across all programs. For example, if a general candidate needs 50% marks, SC/ST candidates need 45%. This applies to all LUACMAT and LUACCET programs at NPGC.

entrance_exam.query: When will the LUACMAT entrance examination be held in 2026?
entrance_exam.answer: The LUACMAT entrance examination will be held on June 23-25, 2026. Different courses have exams on different dates and times. For example, BAJMC is on June 23, while BCA and B.Com (Hons.) are on June 25.

entrance_exam.query: What is the exam pattern for BBA entrance test at NPGC?
entrance_exam.answer: BBA entrance test consists of 2 papers, each of 60 minutes duration with 75 MCQ questions. Total questions are 150. There is no negative marking. Questions cover: GS/GK/Maths (40%), Commerce & Management (20%), Science (20%), and English (20%).

entrance_exam.query: Will there be negative marking in LUACMAT 2026?
entrance_exam.answer: No, there will be no negative marking in any LUACMAT entrance examination for 2026. You only get marks for correct answers; no marks are deducted for wrong answers.

courses_offered.query: What is the difference between BBA and BBA (Digital Business)?
courses_offered.answer: BBA focuses on traditional business administration covering accounting, finance, marketing, and management. BBA (Digital Business) focuses on digital marketing, digital finance management, and IT skills for handling digital business. Both are 3-year programs with similar eligibility criteria.

courses_offered.query: What is B.Voc. and how is it different from regular degree courses?
courses_offered.answer: B.Voc. (Bachelor of Vocational) is a skill-based degree program under Deen Dayal Upadhyay KAUSHAL Kendra. It combines academic learning with practical training and internships. Programs include Software Development, Banking & Finance, and paramedical courses. They offer multiple exit options after each year.

courses_offered.query: Does NPGC offer Bachelor in Public Health (BPH) program?
courses_offered.answer: Yes, NPGC offers BPH (Bachelor in Public Health), a 3-year program designed for students interested in community health and healthcare management. The fee is ₹32,000 per year. Eligibility: 10+2 passed with 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST).

courses_offered.query: What are the paramedical B.Voc. courses offered at NPGC?
courses_offered.answer: NPGC offers 5 paramedical B.Voc. programs through the Centre of Vocational and Futuristic Studies: Medical Lab Technology, Operation Theatre Technology, Physiotherapy, Hospital Management, and Hotel Management. These programs combine academic learning with practical training and internships.

fees_structure.query: What is the total fee for BBA course at NPGC for all semesters?
fees_structure.answer: BBA fee at NPGC is ₹34,500 per semester. For a 3-year 6-semester program, the total course fee is approximately ₹207,000. However, additional charges like caution money and university exam fees apply.

fees_structure.query: Is B.Com (ACCA) more expensive than regular B.Com at NPGC?
fees_structure.answer: Yes, B.Com (ACCA) is significantly more expensive. B.Com (ACCA) costs ₹60,000 per semester, while regular B.Com (Hons.) costs ₹28,600 per semester. The higher fee is due to ACCA training and international certification.

fees_structure.query: Can I pay admission fees online at NPGC?
fees_structure.answer: Yes, admission fees can be paid through multiple methods: Pay Order/DD, online through www.npgc.in, QR Code, Debit/Credit Card, or Internet Banking (banking service charges applicable).

fees_structure.query: Can I get a refund if I cancel my admission within 7 days?
fees_structure.answer: Yes, you can request cancellation and fee refund within 7 days from the date of fee payment to NPGC. After 7 days, you must contact your allotted college for refund requests, which are subject to their policies. NPGC will only process refunds within 7 days.

fees_semester_based.query: What is the fee for BBA at NPGC?
fees_semester_based.answer: BBA fee at NPGC is ₹34,500 per semester. For a 3-year 6-semester program, the total course fee is ₹207,000, excluding additional charges like caution money and university exam fees.

fees_semester_based.query: What is the fee for BCA at NPGC?
fees_semester_based.answer: BCA fee at NPGC is ₹35,500 per semester. For a 3-year 6-semester program, the total course fee is ₹213,000, excluding additional charges like caution money and university exam fees.

fees_semester_based.query: What is the fee for BAJMC at NPGC?
fees_semester_based.answer: BAJMC fee at NPGC is ₹29,100 per semester. For a 3-year 6-semester program, the total course fee is ₹174,600. This makes BAJMC one of the most affordable professional courses at NPGC.

fees_semester_based.query: What is the fee for B.Com (Hons.) at NPGC?
fees_semester_based.answer: B.Com (Hons.) fee at NPGC is ₹28,600 per semester. For a 3-year 6-semester program, the total course fee is ₹171,600. However, if you opt for B.Com with ACCA or CFA integration, the fee is ₹60,000 per semester (₹360,000 total).

fees_semester_based.query: What is the fee for B.Com (E-Commerce) at NPGC?
fees_semester_based.answer: B.Com (E-Commerce) - Apprenticeship Embedded Degree Programme fee at NPGC is ₹28,600 per semester. For a 3-year 6-semester program, the total course fee is ₹171,600, plus practical training cost.

fees_semester_based.query: What is the fee for B.Com (ACCA) at NPGC?
fees_semester_based.answer: B.Com (ACCA) - International Accounting & Finance (integrated with ACCA) fee at NPGC is ₹60,000 per semester. For a 3-year 6-semester program, the total course fee is ₹360,000. This higher fee includes ACCA certification training.

fees_semester_based.query: What is the fee for B.Com (CFA) at NPGC?
fees_semester_based.answer: B.Com (CFA) - Financial Analysis (integrated with CFA) fee at NPGC is ₹60,000 per semester. For a 3-year 6-semester program, the total course fee is ₹360,000. This higher fee includes CFA certification curriculum integration.

fees_annual.query: What is the fee for B.Voc. (Software Development) at NPGC?
fees_annual.answer: B.Voc. (Software Development & E-Governance) fee at NPGC is ₹26,000 per year. For a 3-year program, the total course fee is ₹78,000. This is the most affordable program at NPGC.

fees_annual.query: What is the fee for B.Voc. (Banking & Finance) at NPGC?
fees_annual.answer: B.Voc. (Banking & Finance) fee at NPGC is ₹26,000 per year. For a 3-year program, the total course fee is ₹78,000. This vocational program offers multiple exit options after each year.

fees_annual.query: What is the fee for BPH (Bachelor in Public Health) at NPGC?
fees_annual.answer: BPH (Bachelor in Public Health) fee at NPGC is ₹32,000 per year. For a 3-year program, the total course fee is ₹96,000. This program is designed for students interested in healthcare management and community health.

fees_variants_comparison.query: What is the fee for BBA (Digital Business) at NPGC?
fees_variants_comparison.answer: BBA (Digital Business) fee at NPGC is ₹34,500 per semester, same as regular BBA. For a 3-year 6-semester program, the total course fee is ₹207,000. This variant focuses on digital marketing and digital business management.

fees_variants_comparison.query: Which course has the highest fee at NPGC?
fees_variants_comparison.answer: B.Com (ACCA) and B.Com (CFA) have the highest fees at NPGC: ₹60,000 per semester (₹360,000 total for 3 years). These higher fees include international professional certifications (ACCA/CFA) and specialized training.

fees_variants_comparison.query: Which course has the lowest fee at NPGC?
fees_variants_comparison.answer: B.Voc. (Software Development & E-Governance) and B.Voc. (Banking & Finance) have the lowest fees at NPGC: ₹26,000 per year (₹78,000 total for 3 years). These are skill-based vocational programs under Deen Dayal Upadhyay KAUSHAL Kendra.

fees_additional_payment.query: What are the additional fees I need to pay at NPGC?
fees_additional_payment.answer: Beyond course fees, you need to pay: Counselling fee (₹500 cash), Caution money (refundable, typically ₹3,000-10,000), Registration & Admission process (₹500 each), and University exam fee (varies per semester, typically ₹2,500-3,500).

fees_additional_payment.query: How can I pay the admission fee at NPGC?
fees_additional_payment.answer: You can pay NPGC fees through: Pay Order/DD in favor of National P.G. College, online at www.npgc.in, QR Code, Debit/Credit Card (+ service charge), or Internet Banking (+ service charge). Choose the method that is most convenient for you.

fees_luaccet.query: What is the fee for B.Com under LUACCET at NPGC?
fees_luaccet.answer: NPGC has 550 B.Com seats under LUACCET (220 Regular + 330 Self-Finance). However, the specific fee structure for Regular vs Self-Finance seats is NOT listed in the 2026-27 prospectus. Please contact NPGC at 0522 4021304 or support@npgc.in for exact fees.

fees_luaccet.answer: NPGC has 360 B.Sc. seats under LUACCET: 240 Mathematics group + 120 Biology group. Specific fee structure is NOT listed in the 2026-27 LUACMAT prospectus. Contact NPGC directly at 0522 4021304 for updated fee information.

fees_postgraduate.query: What is the fee for M.A., M.Com, or M.Sc. at NPGC?
fees_postgraduate.answer: Fee structure for postgraduate programs (M.A., M.Com, M.Sc., M.P.H., M.Voc.) is NOT provided in the 2026-27 LUACMAT prospectus. Please visit www.npgc.in, download the Information Bulletin, or contact 0522 4021304 for postgraduate fee details.

fees_refund.query: Can I get a refund if I cancel my admission at NPGC?
fees_refund.answer: Yes, you can request cancellation and full refund within 7 days from the date of fee payment to NPGC. After 7 days, contact your allotted college for refund requests, subject to their policy. NPGC only processes refunds within 7 days.

fees_scholarship.query: Are there scholarships available for NPGC admission?
fees_scholarship.answer: Yes, NPGC offers scholarships for: SC/ST candidates (State Government), OBC candidates (State Government), Merit-based scholarships (General category), and Nirdhan Chhattra Nidhi (fund for economically weak students). Additionally, IGNOU/UPRTOU distance programs offer zero fees for SC/ST. Contact NPGC for details.

documents_required.query: What documents do I need to bring at counselling?
documents_required.answer: You need: Original & photocopies of 10th & 12th mark sheets/certificates, Character Certificate, Transfer Certificate, Caste Certificate (if applicable), and a Pay Order/Demand Draft for the course fee plus ₹500 counselling fee. Mark sheet copies must be self-attested.

seats_availability.query: How many seats are available in BBA at NPGC?
seats_availability.answer: NPGC has 120 seats in BBA under LUACMAT 2026. Additionally, NPGC has 60 seats in BBA (Digital Business). These are proportionally distributed across general and reserved categories as per government reservation policy.

admission_process.query: How can I apply for admission at NPGC?
admission_process.answer: You can apply for admission at NPGC in two ways: (1) Online at www.admission.npgc.in (2) Offline at Counter No. 1 (College Administrative Block). Applications are open from January 15, 2026. Last date for submission is May 31, 2026.

admission_process.query: When will LUACMAT 2026 results be declared?
admission_process.answer: LUACMAT 2026 results are tentatively scheduled to be declared on July 2, 2026. Counselling dates will be announced at the time of the entrance examination. Admit cards will be issued before the exam.

courses_general_queries.query_en: What are all the courses available at NPGC?

(2) Post-Graduate: 12 courses including M.A., M.Sc., M.Com., M.Voc., and M.P.H. in 2 years. (3) Diploma: 6 courses including Advanced Diplomas and Community College programs in 1 year. (4) Certification: 6 certificate courses in 6 months including Forensic Science, Blockchain, and Robotics. All courses are designed to provide career-oriented education with industry relevance.

This includes: 14 Under-Graduate courses, 12 Post-Graduate courses, 6 Diploma courses, and 6 Certificate courses. These courses cover diverse fields in Science, Commerce, Arts, Professional studies, and Vocational training.

courses_general_queries.query_hi: NPGC में कौन से स्नातकोत्तर पाठ्यक्रम उपलब्ध हैं?
courses_general_queries.query_hinglish: NPGC mein kaun se Master's courses available hain?
courses_general_queries.answer: NPGC offers 12 postgraduate courses (2 years each): (1) M.A. specializations: Anthropology, Economics, English, Geography, Political Science, Psychology. (2) M.Sc. specializations: Chemistry, Geoinformatics. (3) Professional: M.Com., M.P.H. (Master in Public Health). (4) Vocational: M.Voc. (Software & E-governance), M.Voc. (Banking, Stock & Insurance). All programs require graduation as eligibility and focus on specialized knowledge and research.

courses_general_queries.query_en: What professional courses does NPGC offer?
courses_general_queries.query_hi: NPGC कौन से व्यावसायिक पाठ्यक्रम प्रदान करता है?
courses_general_queries.query_hinglish: NPGC kaun se professional courses provide karta hai?
courses_general_queries.answer: NPGC offers various professional courses at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels: (1) Undergraduate Professional (3 years): BBA, BBA - Digital Business, BCA, B.Com. - Hons., B.Com. - eCommerce, B.Com. - ACCA, B.Com. - CFA, BAJMC (Journalism & Mass Communication), BPH (Public Health). (2) Postgraduate Professional (2 years): M.Com., M.P.H. (Master in Public Health). These courses provide industry-focused education with career orientation and professional certifications.

courses_general_queries.query_en: What vocational courses does NPGC offer?
courses_general_queries.query_hi: NPGC कौन से व्यावहारिक प्रशिक्षण पाठ्यक्रम प्रदान करता है?
courses_general_queries.query_hinglish: NPGC kaun se vocational training courses provide karta hai?
courses_general_queries.answer: NPGC offers vocational courses (B.Voc. and M.Voc.) under the Deen Dayal Upadhyay KAUSHAL Kendra: (1) Bachelor of Vocation (B.Voc. - 3 years): Software Development & E-Governance, Banking & Finance, Medical Lab Technology, Operation Theatre Technology, Physiotherapy, Hospital Management, Hotel Management. (2) Master of Vocation (M.Voc. - 2 years): Software & E-governance, Banking, Stock & Insurance. These courses combine academic learning with practical training, internships, and multiple exit options after each year.

courses_general_queries.query_en: Does NPGC offer diploma and certificate courses?
courses_general_queries.query_hi: क्या NPGC डिप्लोमा और प्रमाणपत्र पाठ्यक्रम प्रदान करता है?
courses_general_queries.query_hinglish: Kya NPGC diploma aur certificate courses provide karta hai?
courses_general_queries.answer: Yes, NPGC offers both diploma and certificate courses: (1) Diploma Courses (1 year): Advanced Diploma in Analytical Techniques & Instrumental Analysis, Advanced Diploma in Data Analytics, Office Automation & E-Governance (Community College), Banking & Finance (Community College), Post Graduation Diploma in Retail Management, Post Graduation Diploma in Remote Sensing & GIS. (2) Certificate Courses (6 months): Forensic Science, Psychological Counseling, Effective Communication in English, Computer Science, Blockchain Technology and Application, Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. All are designed for skill enhancement and career advancement.

courses_general_queries.query_en: Which courses at NPGC are available in Hindi medium?
courses_general_queries.query_hi: NPGC में हिंदी माध्यम से कौन से पाठ्यक्रम उपलब्ध हैं?
courses_general_queries.query_hinglish: NPGC mein Hindi medium mein kaun se courses available hain?
courses_general_queries.answer: Several courses at NPGC are available in Hindi medium: (1) Under-Graduate: B.A. (Hindi, English), B.Com. (Hindi, English), B.Sc. (Hindi, English), BAJMC (English, Hindi), BPH (English, Hindi). (2) Post-Graduate: M.A. Anthropology (English, Hindi), M.A. Economics (English, Hindi), M.A. Geography (English, Hindi), M.A. Political Science (English, Hindi), M.A. Psychology (English, Hindi), M.Sc. Chemistry (English, Hindi), M.Com. (English, Hindi), M.P.H. (English, Hindi). (3) Diploma & Certificate: Many diploma and certificate courses (English, Hindi). Most professional and technical courses are in English only.

courses_general_queries.query_en: What specialized courses does NPGC offer with international certification?
courses_general_queries.query_hi: NPGC कौन से अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रमाणपत्र के साथ विशेष पाठ्यक्रम प्रदान करता है?
courses_general_queries.query_hinglish: NPGC kaun se international certification ke saath special courses provide karta hai?
courses_general_queries.answer: NPGC offers specialized undergraduate courses with international certifications: (1) B.Com. - ACCA (International Accounting & Finance with ACCA certification) - 3 years. (2) B.Com. - CFA (Financial Analysis with CFA certification) - 3 years. Both courses integrate international professional certifications with the undergraduate curriculum, providing students with globally recognized qualifications. These programs charge premium fees (₹60,000 per semester) compared to regular courses and are designed for students pursuing international accounting and finance careers.

courses_general_queries.query_en: Are there paramedical courses at NPGC?
courses_general_queries.query_hi: क्या NPGC में पैरामेडिकल पाठ्यक्रम हैं?
courses_general_queries.query_hinglish: Kya NPGC mein paramedical courses hain?
courses_general_queries.answer: Yes, NPGC offers several paramedical courses through the Centre of Vocational and Futuristic Studies: (1) B.Voc. (Bachelor of Vocation) programs - 3 years: Medical Lab Technology (50 seats), Operation Theatre Technology (50 seats), Physiotherapy (50 seats), Hospital Management (50 seats), Hotel Management (50 seats). These programs combine academic knowledge with practical hands-on training, internships, and work experience. Students learn clinical skills, medical equipment handling, and healthcare management. All paramedical programs provide multiple exit options after each year and placement opportunities in healthcare sectors.

courses_by_duration.query_hi: NPGC के कौन से पाठ्यक्रम 3 साल की अवधि के हैं?
courses_by_duration.query_hinglish: NPGC ke kaun se courses 3 saal ka program hain?
courses_by_duration.answer: All 14 undergraduate courses at NPGC are 3-year programs: B.A., B.Com., B.Sc., BBA, BBA - Digital Business, BCA, B.Com. - Hons., B.Com. - eCommerce, B.Com. - ACCA, B.Com. - CFA, BAJMC, BPH, B.Voc. (Software Development & E-Governance), B.Voc. (Banking & Finance), Medical Lab Technology, Operation Theatre Technology, Physiotherapy, Hospital Management, Hotel Management. These programs provide comprehensive education over 6 semesters.

courses_by_duration.query_en: Which courses at NPGC are 2-year programs?
courses_by_duration.query_hi: NPGC में कौन से पाठ्यक्रम 2 साल की अवधि के हैं?
courses_by_duration.query_hinglish: NPGC mein kaun se courses 2 saal ka program hain?
courses_by_duration.answer: All 12 postgraduate courses at NPGC are 2-year programs: M.A. (Anthropology, Economics, English, Geography, Political Science, Psychology), M.Sc. (Chemistry, Geoinformatics), M.Voc. (Software & E-governance, Banking/Stock & Insurance), M.Com., M.P.H. (Master in Public Health). These programs are eligibility-based on graduation and provide specialized master-level education over 4 semesters.

courses_by_duration.query_en: What 1-year diploma courses does NPGC offer?
courses_by_duration.query_hi: NPGC कौन से 1 साल की डिप्लोमा पाठ्यक्रम प्रदान करता है?
courses_by_duration.query_hinglish: NPGC kaun se 1 saal ke diploma courses provide karta hai?
courses_by_duration.answer: NPGC offers 6 diploma courses of 1-year duration: (1) Advanced Diploma in Analytical Techniques & Instrumental Analysis. (2) Advanced Diploma in Data Analytics. (3) Office Automation & E-Governance (Community College). (4) Banking & Finance (Community College). (5) Post Graduation Diploma in Retail Management. (6) Post Graduation Diploma in Remote Sensing & GIS. All are structured for skill-based professional development.

courses_by_duration.query_en: What 6-month certificate courses does NPGC offer?
courses_by_duration.query_hi: NPGC कौन से 6 महीने के प्रमाणपत्र पाठ्यक्रम प्रदान करता है?
courses_by_duration.query_hinglish: NPGC kaun se 6 mahine ke certificate courses provide karta hai?
courses_by_duration.answer: NPGC offers 6 certificate courses of 6-month duration: (1) Certificate Course in Forensic Science. (2) Certificate Course in Psychological Counseling. (3) Effective Communication in English. (4) Certificate Course in Computer Science. (5) Introduction to Blockchain Technology and Application. (6) Certificate in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. These short-term courses provide skill enhancement and professional certification for career advancement.

courses_by_mode.query_en: Are there any distance learning or online courses at NPGC?
courses_by_mode.query_hi: क्या NPGC में दूरस्थ शिक्षा या ऑनलाइन पाठ्यक्रम हैं?
courses_by_mode.query_hinglish: Kya NPGC mein distance learning ya online courses hain?
courses_by_mode.answer: Yes, NPGC has a Distance Learning Centre that serves as a Study Centre for IGNOU (Indira Gandhi National Open University) and UPRTOU (Uttar Pradesh Rajarshi Tandon Open University). It offers certificate, diploma, and degree programs in distance mode with regular consultation classes and remedial sessions. Students can pursue qualifications through open distance learning while continuing their work or other commitments. IGNOU and UPRTOU courses provide flexible learning schedules and are particularly useful for working professionals.
